title: Control State Snapshot
description: Read-only evidence contract for material advertiser controls at a decision-relevant point in time. Missing, unsupported, or unproven coverage remains unknown and must never be coerced to zero or unchanged.

entity_type.description: Semantic namespace/type for entity_id, such as keyword or targeting_expression. Required when entity_id is populated; an identifier without its type is not a complete optimization identity.

account_identity.description: Optional explicit event-time advertiser identity. Required with global_advertiser_account_id for profile-less Global SP snapshots; no mapping between identifier generations is inferred.

coverage.description: Explicit proof boundary for material controls. Complete requires every registry-required control to be represented with source-supported evidence; connector limitations may reduce coverage but never shrink requirements.

requirement_provenance.description: Evidence for why this decision surface requires this material-control set. Verified derivation requires a versioned repository-owned requirement_registry_id; connector capability is observational evidence only.

state.description: Source-supported configured state. Use null when evidence is missing or unsupported; never synthesize zero/false/unchanged.

transition_provenance.description: Optional source-supported provenance for how this observed control state may be managed and, when exposed, who caused the latest known transition. Current state does not prove transition authorship; unknown/unsupported provenance must remain unknown.

nested_collection_evidence.description: Per-list completeness proof. Direct state-list fields retain their legacy field-name keys for all material controls, including registry-required object controls; for deeper descendants (including those of top-level list-valued state), use RFC 6901 JSON Pointer keys rooted at state, including escaped object keys and array indices. A top-level list needs collection_evidence; every nested list needs its own nested_collection_evidence. Parent-list evidence does not prove child-list completeness.

control_events.description: Optional post-owned positive event evidence observed strictly between baseline and post timestamps. No/empty events do not prove complete event capture or continuous stability. Event identity and source are adapter-normalized, not Amazon API fields.

event_id.description: Concrete unique event observation identity; not a reused endpoint readback ID.

before_state.description: Observed material state immediately before this transition; never synthesize missing as zero.

after_state.description: Observed material state immediately after this transition; never synthesize missing as zero.

evidence_status.description: Only positively observed events can establish an intervening transition; others are unresolved.

rule_descendant_collection_evidence.description: Optional independent before/after RFC 6901 JSON Pointer completeness evidence for lists nested inside SP schedule/event/budget rule members. Requires paired outer rule_collection_evidence; no claim of full-window event capture.

rule_collection_evidence.description: Optional side-specific collection enumeration/pagination/capability evidence for observed SP schedule/event/budget rule transitions. Omission preserves legacy non-exhaustive event compatibility; explicit partial or one-sided proof is unresolved. This does not certify the complete experiment-window event log.
